text:
Sam K: Heads up — CloudNexus wants a dedicated escalation path for their marketplace listing. They asked for a shared channel + an ephemeral war room pattern for SEVs. Can we sketch a lightweight 'lifeline' template we can reuse across partners?

Emily R: +1. We should avoid creating a permanent channel per partner. Suggest one shared channel per partner cohort (e.g., #partners-cloud-marketplace) for alerts and a private warroom (call + private thread) spawned on SEV open. Draft outline: contact tree, on-call rotation, triage checklist, runbook link.

Ron P: I can draft a runbook patch. Quick clarifying q: who owns the bridge invocation step — Redwood oncall or partner SRE?

Sam K: Redwood owns immediate platform triage (serving/runtime/capacity). Partner owns marketplace provisioning/auth issues. For joint SEVs both join the war room; Redwood leads platform triage and coordinates fallbacks.

Lina M: Proposed signals to trigger the lifeline: Pager (PD), marketplace support ticket flagged sev, webhook alert to shared channel, and a dedicated email alias. Also include a severity->response SLA mapping (ack within 15m, page escalation at 30m).

Alex T: I'll draft a PD escalation mapping: Primary Redwood oncall -> Redwood lead -> Partner oncall -> Partner director. Add an automatic handoff note to the war room when hitting escalation thresholds.

Emily R: Important: include fallback routing policy in the playbook. Example: if Dedicated capacity fails, auto-route to hosted variant with rate caps and a banner for the partner. Need a runbook step to flip routing flags and confirm data isolation guardrails.

PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: add onboarding checklist items — admin contacts, PD escalation contacts, IAM roles, outbound webhook URL, and test alert run (send test alert that creates a warroom). See: https://redwood.internal/partners/runbooks/lifeline-template

Sam K: Drafting the lifeline doc now. Ron — want you to be lead author so you can push a PR under /docs/partners. I'll loop Security for the IAM bits and Legal for the announcement wording. Target: have doc + warroom template before the joint announcement next Wed.

Ron P: On it. I'll post a PR + short README in GH today with the war room template and message snippets (subject, pinned artifacts: logs, trace link, model version, commit). ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Emily R: Also add a short checklist for the partner liaison to run during an active SEV: 1) Confirm oncall names & PD links, 2) Post initial incident summary, 3) Pin key traces + repro steps, 4) Confirm fallback routing executed, 5) Schedule postmortem owner.

Sam K: Great. Tagging @Lina M to validate the pager/webhook wiring and @Alex T for PD mapping review. We'll keep the shared channel muted except for alerts and scheduled syncs.

Lina M: Will verify the webhook and PD policy. If anyone wants the PD escalation JSON snippet, I have a small template: ```json
{
  "service": "redwood-platform",
  "escalation_policy": ["primary_oncall", "redwood_lead", "partner_oncall"]
}
```

Sam K: Awesome. Once Ron posts the PR I'll do a quick pass and we can link it to the partner onboarding checklist in the console. This should make partner SEVs less noisy and faster to resolve. :thumbsup:
